exposure: ~67 kb de novo intragenic deletion on chromosome 2q22.3 involving exons 5-6 of GTDC1
outcome: thin corpus callosum with facial dysmorphisms
expression changes of glycine/serine and cytokine/chemokine signalling pathways
cohort: A female individual diagnosed with a developmental encephalopathy characterized by epilepsy, severe intellectual disability, speech delay, microcephaly, and thin corpus callosum with facial dysmorphisms.
finding: The novel GTDC1 de novo intragenic deletion is implicated in neurodevelopmental impairment by altering glycine metabolism, expanding the phenotypic spectrum to include microcephaly and epilepsy.
